input.title: Pick Color from Image

content.title: Online Image Color Picker
content.p1: Need to find the exact color used in a photo? Our free Image Color Picker lets you upload any image and easily extract the HEX, RGB, or HSL color code from any pixel.
content.p2: Whether you're a designer matching a brand color or just curious about a shade, our tool provides a zoom magnifier for pixel-perfect precision.

formats.title: Accurate Codes
formats.desc: Instantly get HEX, RGB, and HSL values for any selected pixel.

zoom.title: Magnifier Tool
zoom.desc: Built-in magnifying glass allows you to select pixels with extreme precision.

private.title: 100% Client-Side
private.desc: Your images are processed in your browser and never uploaded to a server.

how_to.title: How to Pick Colors
list: Upload your image or drag & drop it.
Hover over the image to inspect colors with the magnifier.
Click to lock selection or copy the HEX/RGB codes.
